description: DVC logical cage identifier, e.g. B6_M_12_3401
note: One enclosure per cage column; identifier kept verbatim.

description: Individually ventilated cage monitored by the external DVC board
note: Dimensions come from the vendor product sheet, not from the export.

description: Rack identifier (AAAA) where the cage is inserted
note: Rack + position modelled as one schema:Place.

description: Slot on the rack (A6, C5, ...)
note: Only the latest position is kept: hcm:locatedIn is not time-bounded, so position history is lost.

description: Cohort label carried by every row; strain/sex only by naming convention
note: Strain and sex cannot be asserted on a group in 0.3.0 (hcm-bio:hasStrain/hasBiologicalSex have domain Subject); recorded as rdfs:comment.

description: No animal identity and no housing density in the export
note: Cage-level group with unknown membership; individual hcm-bio:Subject instances cannot be created.

description: First INSERTED event to the end of the export
note: Time-bounded assignment of the cage group to the cage.

description: Cage placed in / removed from the rack
note: Online/offline validity intervals generated by the rack-controller cage-detection assessment.

description: Cloud bookkeeping events for the cage record
note: Software lifecycle events without a home-cage meaning; deliberately out of scope.

description: ISO 8601 with milliseconds and UTC offset
Redundant local-time decomposition of the timestamp
note: Derivable from the timestamp; not materialised separately.

description: Proprietary 1-min locomotion index derived from 12 capacitive electrodes
note: No HCMO observation subtype accepts a numeric activity result about a cage group; the generic sosa:Observation is used.

description: Cohort-level aggregates across online cages per bin
note: Statistical summaries are derivable from the per-cage observations; HCMO records primary observations only.

description: 12-electrode capacitive sensing board under each cage, 4 Hz
note: One sensor per cage; monitoredBy inverse asserted on the enclosure.

description: Rack-level hardware collecting board data
Cloud software computing and exporting the smoothed index
note: Derivation algorithm is proprietary; only the attribution is recorded.

description: CSV files (wide index table, event log)
12 channels x 4 Hz per cage, not exported
note: Not present in the export; would map to hcm-tech:TimeSeries if available.

description: Rack environmental monitor channels (documented, absent from this export)
note: Would map to hcm-obs:EnvironmentObservation with hcm-env:EnvironmentalProperty; absent from cohort 7623 files.

description: Derived bedding-wetness and urination proxies (documented, absent from this export)
note: Dual environmental/physiological role; absent from cohort 7623 files.

description: Rack light schedule (documented, absent from this export)
note: hcm-env:LightCycle would apply; the export does not state the light schedule, so dark-phase questions are unanswerable for DVC.
